i1.text: Meet Aisha, the money assistant inside Wavvy Wallet.

i2.text: Ask her anything, in plain words. Here are six things she can do for you.

h1.text: To find her, open Wavvy Wallet, and tap Chat at the bottom.

h2.text: The first time, read the short note, then tap, Continue to chat.

c1q.text: Number one. Ask Aisha about your spending.

c1a.text: Type a question, like, how much did I spend this month? Then tap send.

c1b.text: Aisha adds it all up in seconds, and shows how much is still untagged.

c1c.text: Ask where most of your money goes, and she names your biggest costs.

c2q.text: Number two. Find any payment, fast.

c2a.text: Ask about anyone you pay. Show me my payments to Mary Wanjiku.

c2b.text: She finds every payment, with the dates and fees, and even spots a pattern.

c3q.text: Number three. Tag payments, just by chatting.

c3a.text: Tell her what a payment was for. Tag the Kings Court payment as rent.

c3b.text: Aisha always asks before she changes anything. Tap, Allow Once.

c3c.text: Done. Your rent is tagged, and she offers to do it every month.

c4q.text: Number four. Cash spending counts too.

c4a.text: Paid with cash? Just tell her. I paid two hundred and fifty shillings cash for lunch.

c4b.text: Allow it, and the cash payment is added to your list.

c5q.text: Number five. Plan ahead with Aisha.

c5a.text: Ask her to plan a weekend trip to Diani, with twenty thousand shillings.

c5b.text: She splits it into transport, a place to stay, food, activities, and a little extra, and checks it against your usual spending.

c5c.text: Say yes, and she creates a trip category, so you can track every shilling.

c6q.text: And number six. Aisha can change the app, and listen too.

c6a.text: Ask for a purple theme, and the whole app changes colour.

c6b.text: Ask for green again, and it's back.

c6c.text: Rather talk than type? Tap the microphone, and just speak.

o1.text: Aisha is in beta, so double check anything important. Open Wavvy Wallet, tap Chat, and say hello.
